Method of Attack: Backdoor Microsoft Exchange servers via malicious native-code IIS module
Dropping and managing arbitrary files on compromised servers
Remote command execution on backdoored devices
Connecting to endpoints within victim's local network and manipulating network traffic
Collecting information from victims' network and infected devices
Delivering additional payloads such as PowerSploit-based Mimikatz reflective loader, Mimikatz SSP, ProcDump, and Avast memory dump tool
Attack Vector: Exploitation of Exchange server vulnerabilities (ProxyLogon attacks)
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious IIS module samples deployed on 34 servers of 24 organizations as late as June 2022
Not flagged as malicious by popular online file scanning service months after discovery
